newsitem.title: USA: PIA sees restructuring plan costs in Q3.
newsitem.headline: PIA sees restructuring plan costs in Q3.

text.p: PIA Merchandising Services Inc said Thursday it expects the costs of a restructuring plan currently under development to be reflected in third quarter results.
In a written statement, the company said it has not reacted quickly enough to align its cost structure with the changing mix of business during the first half of the year.
The company said its main priority is to get expenses under control and to develop a restructuring plan which results in an appropriate cost structure for the business.
The company reported a loss per share for the second quarter of $0.35 compared with a profit of $0.03 for the same period a year ago. Revenues were $31.6 million compared to $26.9 million
The company said the latest quarter's per share results reflect a 502,000 share repurchase. An additional 5,000 shares were purchased in July. No further share purchases are planned.
